basic.name: 普通攻击：星仪序曲
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
爱丽丝通过属性异常积蓄触发[强击]时，下一次发动的[普通攻击]第五段获得强化。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG.
When Alice triggers Assault through Attribute Anomaly Buildup, the 5th hit of her next Basic Attack is enhanced.

special.name: 特殊技：破晓突刺
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
丢出剑攻击并穿过前方敌人，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时可以触发[极限闪避]；
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Hurl the blade to strike and pass through enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered.
After triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack] to follow up with the 5th hit of a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：极光突刺·北十字
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，向前拖曳摇杆并点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough energy, drag the joystick forward and press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，向前拖曳摇杆并点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
突刺攻击并穿过前方敌人，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时可以触发[极限闪避]，并回复10点[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, drag the joystick forward and press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
A thrust attack that goes through enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Dodge and restores 10 Blade Etiquette.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：剑闪之仪

dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:

Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：星落间章
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：

chain.description:

Unleashes powerful consecutive slashes at enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：星芒终章

对前方大范围敌人发动强力多段斩击，造成大量物理伤害；

Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.

Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
队伍中任意角色对敌人施加物理异常状态后，在异常状态的持续期间，爱丽丝每0.95秒对其额外造成基于该物理异常伤害比例2.5%的伤害，并使物理异常状态下的敌人被触发[紊乱]效果时，每有1秒物理异常状态剩余时间，[紊乱]效果的伤害倍率提升18%，最多提升180%；
爱丽丝攻击命中敌人时，累积[剑仪]，爱丽丝通过属性异常积蓄触发[强击]时，回复10点[剑仪]，[剑仪]的上限为300点，每100点为1格；
三段蓄力的[普通攻击：星芒圆舞曲]的终结一击命中敌人时，触发特殊的[强击]效果[极性强击]，无视属性积蓄进度造成一次原本[强击]效果100%的伤害，并可以与包括物理异常效果在内的其他属性异常效果互相结算[紊乱]；
爱丽丝触发[强击]时，物理异常积蓄效率提升25%，持续30秒。
facts.textEn:
After any squad member inflicts a Physical Anomaly on an enemy, Alice deals additional DMG each 0.95s of its active duration, equal to 2.5% of the original Physical Anomaly DMG. If Disorder is triggered while the enemy is suffering a Physical Anomaly, for every 1s of remaining Physical Anomaly duration, the Disorder DMG multiplier increases by 18%, up to a max of 180%.
When Alice's attacks hit an enemy, she builds up Blade Etiquette. When she triggers an Assault through Anomaly Buildup, she gains 10 Blade Etiquette. Blade Etiquette has a maximum of 300, with each 100 being 1 bar.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz lands, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarity Assault, dealing 100% of the original Assault DMG, ignoring Anomaly Buildup progress. This can be combined with any Attribute Anomaly, including Physical Anomaly, to trigger Disorder.
When Alice triggers Assault on an enemy, her Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 25% for 30s.

cinema.name: 掌心的芫荽
cinema.description: 爱丽丝触发[极性强击]时，回复25点[剑仪]；爱丽丝触发[强击]时，目标的防御力降低20%，持续30秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Alice triggers a Polarity Assault, she gains 25 Blade Etiquette. When she triggers Assault against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.

cinema.name: 剑尖的鼠尾草
cinema.description: [终结技：星芒终章]的终结一击命中敌人时，触发[极性强击]；全队角色造成的[强击]伤害提升15%；物理异常状态下的敌人被结算的[紊乱]伤害提升15%；进入战场时，爱丽丝立刻获得1000点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ultimate: Starfall Finale's Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers Polarity Assault. All squad members' Assault DMG increases by 15%. Disorder DMG against enemies suffering from Physical Anomaly increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.

cinema.name: 对称主义
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 唇间的迷迭香
cinema.description: 爱丽丝无视目标10%物理伤害抗性；强化后的[普通攻击：星仪序曲]累积的物理异常积蓄值提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Alice ignores 10% of the target's Physical RES. Enhanced Basic Attack: Celestial Overture accumulates 25% more Physical Anomaly Buildup.

cinema.name: 灵异渴求
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 心中的百里香
cinema.description: 爱丽丝发动三段蓄力的[普通攻击：星芒圆舞曲]或[终结技：星芒终章]时，进入[决胜状态]，持续30秒，在持续期间，队伍中任意角色攻击命中目标后的短时间内，爱丽丝对目标发动1次额外攻击，造成等同于爱丽丝3300%异常精通的物理伤害，必定暴击，该效果1秒内最多触发一次，最多触发6次，再次获得[决胜状态]时刷新可触发次数。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Alice uses a third-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz or Ultimate: Starfall Finale, she enters the Victory State for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the Victory State again refreshes the available trigger count.

ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating this skill restores 200 Blade Etiquette.
Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：交替穿刺
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击和踢击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

140100001.name: 普通攻击：星仪序曲
140100001.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
爱丽丝通过属性异常积蓄触发[强击]时，下一次发动的[普通攻击]第五段获得强化。
140100001.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG.
When Alice triggers Assault through Attribute Anomaly Buildup, the 5th hit of her next Basic Attack is enhanced.

140100002.name: 普通攻击：星芒圆舞曲
140100002.description:
爱丽丝的[剑仪]达到1格时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
长按进入蓄力，消耗至多3格[剑仪]，松开 【普通攻击键】 或[剑仪]不满1格时，爱丽丝将根据当前蓄力段数以目标敌人为中心发动多段斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
三段蓄力的[普通攻击：星芒圆舞曲]的终结一击命中敌人时，触发特殊的[强击]效果[极性强击]，无视属性积蓄进度造成一次原本[强击]效果100%的伤害，并可以与包括物理异常效果在内的其他属性异常效果互相结算[紊乱]；
命中敌人时，不累积[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
140100002.descriptionEn:
When Alice's Blade Etiquette reaches 1 bar, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Hold to charge, expending up to 3 bars of Blade Etiquette. Release [Basic Attack] or when Blade Etiquette is below 1 bar, Alice performs a series of slashes in an area centered on the target enemy, with the number of hits determined by charge level, dealing massive Physical DMG.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz hits, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarity Assault. This deals DMG equal to 100% of the original Assault, ignoring Anomaly Buildup, and can interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical, to trigger Disorder.
Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

140100004.name: 强化特殊技：极光突刺·北十字
140100004.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross
140100004.description:
能量足够时，向前拖曳摇杆并点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
突刺攻击并穿过前方敌人，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时可以触发[极限闪避]，并回复10点[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
140100004.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, drag the joystick forward and press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
A thrust attack that goes through enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Dodge and restores 10 Blade Etiquette.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

140100005.name: 强化特殊技：极光突刺·南十字
140100005.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross
140100005.description:
能量足够时，不拖曳或者向后方拖曳摇杆并点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
后退并发动斩击随后向前穿刺，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时可以触发[极限闪避]，并回复10点[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
140100005.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, and without moving the joystick or when dragging it backwards, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Back away with a slash, then thrust forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Dodge and restores 10 Blade Etiquette.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

140100010.name: 终结技：星芒终章
140100010.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力多段斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，回复200点[剑仪]；
命中敌人时，不累积[剑仪]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
